stem.en: A government's five-year term ends. It says it did well and will stay on with no election. What is wrong with this?

text.en: Nothing: a good record earns extra years.
It must first ask the President for more time.
It must first hold a debate in Parliament on its record.
The people have not given it a fresh mandate.

explanation.en: A government cannot continue beyond its term without seeking the people's mandate again. Doing well may help it win the next election, but it does not replace that election.

hints.en: Who gives a government the right to continue, and how do they give it?
